title: Console settings and what they change on the storefront
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/settings-effects.e2e.ts. settings:write (owner, admin) is needed for every change; every change is audited in staff_actions and deletes the storefront caches.

steps.title: Default markup to 10 %
steps.body: Edit the Default rule (priority 1000, cannot be deleted, narrowed or dated) to 10 %.
steps.expect: `PATCH /v1/console/settings/markup-rules/{id}` (If-Match) → `200`; the next search's `flight_offers.markup_amount` = 10 % of net; existing offers keep their price.

steps.title: Booking service fee
steps.body: Create a fee of €7.50 per booking.
steps.expect: `POST …/fee-rules` → `201`; the next priced offer's breakdown and `fee_amount` carry it; `fee_rules.refundable` decides whether a cancellation returns it.

steps.title: Brand colour
steps.expect: `PATCH /v1/console/settings/storefront` → `storefront_settings.version` + 1; Redis `t:<tenantId>:<env>:sf:*` deleted; the storefront shows it once its own 5-minute sessionStorage copy is gone.

steps.title: Content page
steps.body: Create a published page shown in the footer.
steps.expect: `storefront_pages` row; `t:…:pages:<locale>` deleted; the storefront serves it at `/p/<slug>` (Caddy rewrites it to p.html) and lists it in the footer.

steps.title: Images
steps.body: Upload a logo (PNG/JPEG/WebP/ICO, ≤ 1 MiB); try a renamed text file.
steps.expect: `201` `storefront_assets` + file under `STORAGE_DIR/tenant_<key>/…`; the fake image → `422 ASSET_INVALID` (content sniffed). Deleting an asset in use → `409`.

steps.title: E-mail template
steps.body: Edit `booking.confirmed` with a syntax error, then preview a valid one, then reset.
steps.expect: `422 TEMPLATE_INVALID` line by line, nothing saved; preview renders sample data; reset deletes the tenant row and the code default applies.

steps.title: Offers per search
steps.body: Search defaults → 40 offers; then "Use the default".
steps.expect: The next storefront search asks Amadeus for 40 and lists ≤ 40; back to 150 (DEFAULT_OFFERS_PER_SEARCH) after reset.
